lockFileMaintenance.description: With minimumReleaseAge set here, Renovate refreshes the lock with npm install --before=<7 days ago>, so it only moves to versions at least 7 days old. A lock refresh has no single release date, so timestamp-optional stops the stability check waiting forever. If --before fails (a locked package is newer than the cutoff), Renovate retries without it and notes that in the PR, so this stays manual-merge.

packageRules.description: Auto-merge minor/patch PRs when CI passes (7-day wait, stricter than the 3-day default). Lock file maintenance has its own 7-day limit above and stays manual-merge (see its description).
Auto-open PRs for major updates; review manually
0.x updates can break on any bump, so they stay manual.
